label: Real Estate / Property
description: Property brokers, real-estate agencies, rental consultants, small developers with a local office.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Property is a trust purchase with long gaps between deals. A slow, steady review trickle beats a burst once a year.

issueTaxonomy.label: Listing did not match reality
issueTaxonomy.action: Photograph every property yourself on the day it is listed, and remove any listing you have not personally verified this month.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the property not matching what was shown
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: property waisi na nikalne jaisi dikhayi gayi thi

issueTaxonomy.label: Slow or no response
issueTaxonomy.action: Commit to a same-day first reply on every enquiry, and log any enquiry not answered within four working hours.

issueTaxonomy.label: Hidden brokerage / charges
issueTaxonomy.action: State the full brokerage and any additional charge in writing before the first site visit.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: charges you were not told about upfront
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: pehle se na bataye gaye kharche

issueTaxonomy.label: Site visit problems
issueTaxonomy.action: Confirm site-visit time and address the evening before, and never schedule a visit without the key in hand.
hints: no one came for the site visit

issueTaxonomy.label: Documentation / paperwork delays
issueTaxonomy.action: Give a written checklist of documents and a dated timeline at agreement stage, and update it weekly.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the paperwork taking longer than it should

issueTaxonomy.label: Pressure / pushy selling
issueTaxonomy.action: Remove urgency claims from the pitch entirely, and never quote a deadline you cannot show in writing.

issueTaxonomy.label: Token / advance not refunded
issueTaxonomy.action: Escalate offline immediately. Put the token refund terms in writing before accepting any advance.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the delay in returning your money
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: paise wapas milne mein hui deri

issueTaxonomy.label: Disappeared after the deal
issueTaxonomy.action: Schedule one follow-up call at 7 days and one at 30 days after possession for every closed deal.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the drop in contact after the deal
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: deal ke baad sampark kam hone

issueTaxonomy.label: Professionalism / behaviour
issueTaxonomy.action: Set a fixed intro script and dress-and-punctuality standard for every site visit.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the way you were dealt with

issueTaxonomy.label: Price kept changing
issueTaxonomy.action: Quote the all-in price in writing at first contact and do not revise it without a written reason.

praiseTaxonomy.label: Honest and transparent
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the process was straight with you
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: poori baat saaf saaf rakhi gayi

praiseTaxonomy.label: Quick, reliable responses
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: you could always get hold of us

praiseTaxonomy.label: Showed relevant options
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the options shown were the right ones

praiseTaxonomy.label: Help with paperwork
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: kaagzi kaam aasaan kar diya gaya

praiseTaxonomy.label: No pressure
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: you were given room to decide
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: aapko soch samajh kar faisla lene diya gaya
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseMarathi: तुम्हाला विचार करून निर्णय घेऊ दिला गेला

exampleReplies: Thank you for raising this. An enquiry going unanswered is not acceptable on our side. Please call the office and ask for the manager so we can check what happened with your enquiry.
Thank you for writing this — glad the process was straightforward.

staffAskScript.when: After handover or agreement signing, once the client confirms the process went smoothly.
staffAskScript.line: If the process worked for you, an honest review helps the next family decide who to trust. The QR on this card takes a minute.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Agar process theek raha ho, toh ek honest review agle family ko trust decide karne mein help karta hai. Is card ka QR ek minute lega.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: प्रक्रिया सुरळीत झाली असेल, तर प्रामाणिक अभिप्राय पुढच्या कुटुंबाला विश्वास ठरवायला मदत करतो. या कार्डवरचा QR एक मिनिट घेतो.
doNot: Never offer a brokerage discount or any benefit in exchange for a review.
Never ask only the clients whose deals closed well.
Never write a review on a client's phone.
Never ask a client to remove or edit a review.
Never mention a property address, deal value or client name in a public reply.

profileGapChecks.label: Services and areas covered not listed
No recent office or property photos
Registration / licence details not shown publicly

contentTemplates.label: Reply — unanswered enquiry
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for raising this. An enquiry going unanswered is not acceptable on our side. Please call the office and ask for the manager so we can check exactly what happened with yours.

— {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Reply — positive review
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for writing this. Glad the process was straightforward — do reach out if anything comes up later.

— {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Handover card subhead
contentTemplates.body: Scan and share your honest experience. One minute.

kit.placement: Handed over with the agreement folder or at key handover.
kit.moment: After handover or agreement signing, once the client confirms it went smoothly.
kit.headline: How did the process go?
kit.subhead: Scan and share your honest experience. One minute.
